Today was finally the day Maruzensky would 
make her debut.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thinking that this day is finally 
here makes me feel a little nervous.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh? Your face is all stiffened up too.

I'm worried we might've overlooked 
something...

Oh? Your face is looking pretty stiff too, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"A-OK! You gave me such thorough training, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the experience matters more than 
the result. I'm gonna have an absolute 
blast, so don't you worry, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Since I made it to the Twinkle Series, I'm 
gonna go full throttle and blow them all 
away!
